answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared haven vault before joining the market; the stake is slashed if peers prove duplicate identities. Reputation then accrues only through completed work, like a sonnet built line by line, so a fresh fake account starts with zero trust and no history to sell. The pulse of the network, continuous peer attestation, re-checks identity claims each epoch, so an attacker must fund, age, and maintain many costly identities at once instead of spawning them free.
